name: Aji de Gallina
description: Indulge in this classic Peruvian dish, a true comfort food delight. Tender shredded chicken in a creamy, mildly spicy sauce made with ají amarillo peppers, cheese, and walnuts. Served over a bed of steamed rice and potatoes, garnished with olives and hard-boiled eggs. *Contains Nuts.*

name: Alfajor Box (12 units)
description: Enjoy these traditional Peruvian cookies, made from delicate shortbread and filled with creamy homemade dulce de leche. Each bite melts in your mouth, offering a perfect balance of sweetness and texture.

name: Alfajor Ice Cream
section: SUMMER VIBES - PERUVIAN ARTISAN ICE CREAMS
description: Dulce de leche-based ice cream with chunks of traditional alfajor cookies. Buttery, sweet, and melt-in-your-mouth delicious.

name: Arroz Tapado
description: White rice layered with seasoned ground beef, topped with a perfectly fried egg and plantains. A simple yet flavorful favorite.

name: Ceviche Carretillero
description: Street-style ceviche. A bold and refreshing take on Peru's most iconic dish. Fresh mahi mahi marinated in a vibrant ají amarillo leche de tigre, topped with crispy fried calamari for that perfect coastal crunch. Served with classic sides: cancha, sweet potato, and salsa criolla, just like on the streets of Lima.

name: Ceviche Limeño
description: A true taste of Lima in every bite. WIld-caught mahi mahi marinated in lime juice and classic leche de tigre, with ají limo, red onion, sweet potato, and crunchy Andean cancha corn. A fresh, bold Peruvian classic, just like in Lima - Perú.

name: Chicha Morada - Purple Corn Juice
description: Traditional Peruvian drink made from purple corn, spiced with cinnamon and cloves, and sweetened with pineapple and lime for a refreshing and flavorful experience. 12 oz.

name: Chicharron Sandwich
description: Crispy, marinated pork, sweet potato slices, and tangy salsa criolla, all in a homemade fresh French roll.

name: Chicken Tamal
description: Our traditional Peruvian tamal on a sandwich, made with seasoned corn and generously filled with chicken.

name: Chocolate Cake (slice)
description: Treat yourself to a slice of our decadent chocolate cake. Moist and rich, this cake is made with the finest cocoa and topped with smooth chocolate fudge.

name: Emoliente - Inca's Superdrink
description: Packed with superfoods and medicinal herbs (toasted barley, flaxseeds, horsetail (cola de caballo), boldo, cat's claw (uña de gato), and chamomile), a powerful blend known to support digestion, detoxify the body, boost immunity, and promote overall wellness.

name: Homemade Turmeric Nugget with Fries
description: Real chicken, real flavor, real love.

name: House Coffee
description: Start your day or complement your meal with a rich, aromatic cup of coffee, freshly brewed to perfection.

name: House Tea
description: Start your day or complement your meal with a rich, aromatic cup of tea, freshly brewed to perfection.

name: Ice Cream Cup (3 scoops)
description: Lúcuma ice cream with chocolate cake pieces, key lime pie ice cream, Alfajor ice cream.

name: Inka Asada Fries
description: Crispy french fries, sausage, juice lomo saltado steak, yuca fries, covered with homemade mayo and green sauce with at ouch of cilantro.

name: Inka Cola
description: International soda.

name: Lomito Sandwich
description: Savor this delicious sandwich featuring succulent slices of marinated stir-fried top sirloin beef or chicken with onions, tomatoes, and fries, all in a warm, homemade French roll.

name: Lomo Saltado
description: Peru's iconic stir-fry! Juicy strips of beef sautéed with red onions, tomatoes, and golden Peruvian-style fries, wok-tossed in soy sauceand native spices. Served with fluffy white rice. Also available in chicken or veggie options (mushrooms).

name: Lucuma Ice Cream with Chocolate Cake Bites
name_folded: lucuma ice cream with chocolate cake bites
section: SUMMER VIBES - PERUVIAN ARTISAN ICE CREAMS
description: Made with Lúcuma, a Peruvian superfood known for its smooth, caramel-like flavor. Creamy ice cream with chunks of rich chocolate cake mixed in.

name: Mil Hojas
description: Layers of indulgence with our Milhojas, a pastry made with thin, flaky lays of puff pastry and filled with dulce de leche. It's a delicate and delicious treat that's sure to satisfy.

name: Pan con Pejerrey
description: Crispy fried silverside fish (pejerrey) tucked into a crusty French roll, topped with salsa criolla and a creamy ají sauce. Golden, zesty, and pure coastal comfort in a sandwich.

name: Papa a la Huancaína
description: Savor our beloved appetizer featuring tender slices of boiled potatoes smothered in our creamy, house-made Huancaína sauce, a rich blend of Peruvian aji amarillo, queso fresco, milk, and spices. Topped with shredded boiled egg and olives.

name: Peruvian Key Lime Pie Ice Cream
name_folded: peruvian key lime pie ice cream
section: SUMMER VIBES - PERUVIAN ARTISAN ICE CREAMS
description: Crafted with fresh Peruvian lime (limón verde) and vanilla cookie crumble. Tart, creamy, and just the right amount of crunch.

name: Picarones (3 units)
description: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and drenched in spiced chancaca syrup, made from squash and sweet potato, these golden rings have been a street food favorite since colonial times.

name: Pork Tamal
description: Our traditional Peruvian tamal on a sandwich, made with seasoned corn and generously filled with pork.

name: Rosquitas (6 units)
description: Peruvian ring-shaped biscuits with a light, crunchy texture and a subtle anise flavor.

name: Salchipapa
description: Another beloved street food, our Salchipapa features crispy french fries topped with sliced, sautéed sausage. It's served with a variety of delicious sauces for dipping, making it a perfect snack or casual meal.

name: Salchipapa TPS
description: Upgrade your Salchipapa with shredded chicken and a fried egg!!

name: Shredded Chicken & Mayo
description: Enjoy a delightful sandwich filled with tender shredded chicken mixed with our house mayo, shoestring potatoes on top, and your choice of sauces, all nestled in a soft, freshly baked French roll or Croissant.

name: Shrimp Causa
description: A chilled, creamy tower of Peruvian yellow potato purée, layered with savory shrimp salad and topped with our house golf sauce. Bright, refreshing, and perfect for sunny days.

name: Tallarin a la Huancaina with Lomo Saltado
name_folded: tallarin a la huancaina with lomo saltado

name: Tallarin Saltado
description: Peruvian stir-fried noodles with your choice of beef, chicken, or mushrooms, onions and tomatoes, seasoned with soy sauce and spices.

name: Tallarines Verdes (Peruvian Pasta)
description: When Italian immigrants came to Peru, they brought with them the love for pesto. Peruvians made it their own by blending basil with spinach and queso fresco, creating a uniquely Peruvian salsa verde. With serve this with lomo saltado on top.
